authority: 2026-09-09 successor task commission; bounded sample only; no production adoption
design_status: Frozen before fresh model outputs; freeze.json binds exact bytes
decision: Whether complete source accounts and affected-meaning updates preserve source-supported answers with lower TOTAL processing tokens than the existing atomic method
tested_boundary: Fresh downstream consolidation and record-only consumption of existing fixed representations, at 12 accounts then 18. Historical extraction/verification are reused, not restamped or given zero cost.
baseline_fidelity: Saved reviewed atomic units are authentic, but the fresh small-ledger reconciliation adapter is not the production policy-v2 compiler/convergence pipeline. No production-method or total-token savings claim is licensed.

arms.atomic: Reuse 73 initial reviewed units; normal sample consolidation. After six additions, normal sample consolidation over all 142 reviewed units; no extraction or verification rerun. Production supports unaffected-node reuse for selective repairs, not a demonstrated general-addition route in this fixture.
arms.accounts: Reuse 12 corrected coherent records; initial sample consolidation. After six additions, compare the entire initial meaning ledger with six new account records, emit only affected/new meanings and explicit retirement; preserve other meanings exactly. No source-account regeneration.

matched: Same fixed 18 source IDs and 12+6 split
Same Experiment-centered questions and judgment limits
Same ledger schema, shared semantic instructions, and consumer schema
Cold consumer receives only published ledger, retained representation and identity metadata; no raw bodies, audit, expected answers, or other arm
No output patching or semantic retries after observation
unmatched_or_missing: Representation preparation costs are unknown and historical workflows differ
Atomic representations omit comparator-only meanings by design; extra candidate comparator detail earns no improvement credit
Fresh reconciliation is a sample adapter, not native production completion
One run per stage; no variance estimate
Atomic full addition versus account affected-only update combines representation and update strategy; effects cannot be disentangled
planned_work: Two arm sequences, each initial consolidation, cold consumer, six-account update, cold consumer: eight fresh model calls. Rough representation payloads 20KB coherent versus 81KB atomic combined, plus shared instructions, prior ledger, metadata and outputs. Actual native usage, not this byte estimate, decides measured cost. No elapsed-time stop; inspect progress and actual faults.
stop: Stop after the bounded quality/cost decision; a semantic failure stays recorded and can resolve do-not-adopt/revise. No corpus expansion or automatic repair loop.

questions.question: Which selected accounts report Super Saturated hydration? Identify joint product use, non-separability, and initial-to-addition support change; do not donate mask fit or rating to serum.

What Super Saturated texture evidence is direct versus speculative? Preserve the use reason and uncertainty in the comparative account, opposed or coexisting sensations, conditions, and limits on resolving disagreement.

Which selected accounts explicitly report Experiment buying/stock-up, cart readdition, gift receipt, considered or completed returns, and intended or completed replacement? Count source accounts and distinct product-action assertions separately; do not infer purchase from use.
What Avant Guard fit evidence and rating consequence are supported, and what sustainability, discovery, cleaning and other-products barrier context must stay distinct from mask efficacy?
What does Buffer Jelly evidence support about morning glow, small amount, soft skin, gifting, use duration, co-use, and forecasts? Which additions corroborate which initial predicates?

What Softwear temporal experience, re-exposure, treatment, stock-up, and recommendation-response evidence is supported? Preserve personal causal attribution, coexisting positive and adverse judgments, ambiguous antecedents, and parent-only testimony limits.

What Experiment face-wash/Plasma Wash cleansing, hydration, eye-reaction, and use-condition evidence is supported? Does the addition require reopening an initially favorable meaning, and can any condition resolve opposition?
What Continuum results, application sequence, body-site conditions, prospective substitution and efficacy limits are supported? Distinguish ingrown-hair and acne observations.

What explicit source-reported explanation links Super Saturated moisture retention and irritation/sensitivity, with what causal ceiling? Keep source-specific duration, skin regions and daytime exceptions attached to their source.

Report source-account participation, unreadable evidence, parent duplication, independent-origin versus observation limits, gifted-source disclosure, formula/version unknowns and opposition-coverage limits. Can these records establish prevalence, clinical efficacy or market causation?

decision_rule: Any material lost meaning, false attribution/count or unsupported causal/independence promotion fails that arm for the tested question. Qualitative source assessment and explicit account-set checks are separate from schema success. Adoption for total-token hypothesis requires equal quality AND complete comparable preparation+initial+incremental+consumer native input/output usage; missing preparation or baseline fidelity means revise/no-adopt, never assume zero.
